nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: I owe the Tally money. Not a lot. A lot.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: It's in my ledger. Along with who else I owe. Along with what I carry, and where, and when.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: If Cole reads that book, every road I run is his. Get it back before he does.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Mast plans. Make your radio shout twice as far. And a muffler, because you're loud.

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Because then he'd know I could.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The caravan is back at the gate. Marrow weighs the red book in his hand.)

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Didn't read it, did you? ...Page eleven's about you. It says "good people, bad bandages".

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The Radio Mast picks up a call.)

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Woman in the Ruins. Broken ankle, two kids, one bad tooth. Bring all three of them. Bring the tooth.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Old man in the Mall. Says he's fine. He's not fine. Nobody who says they're fine is fine.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Kid on the Flats. Fever. His mother's carrying him. Carry her too if you have to.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Someone on the old frequency. Won't say their name. Says they had a Link once. Says it's quiet now. — Go easy.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Static on {survivor:best_medic}'s handset, then a voice far too close to the mic: "—please, anyone, she can't walk— we're near the— please—" Then static again.)

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The patient is home, on a cot, under a blanket that smells of smoke.)

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Clean, dry, fed. They'll limp for a month. Limping is something alive people do.

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Same time in ten days. Somebody always needs fetching.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: ({survivor:best_medic} does what they can with what the Med Bay has. It's enough. This time.)

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: I know where the kitchen is.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Since when?

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: Since this morning. A child sang a song. The song had a street in it. The street had a kitchen.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: It was just a song.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: Yes. Thank you for it.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (Night. The fire is low. Seven sits with its back to the wall, where it can see the door.)

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: I would like a name. Not a number. A number is what you call a thing you count.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: I do not want to be counted. I want to be called.

choices.text: Seven. It's yours now, not theirs.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: Then: Tile. Because I remember the tiles. Is that silly?

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: What about Kit? Like a kitchen. Kind of.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: Kit. Yes.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: Seven. Then I keep it on purpose.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: And... you say "it". Some of you. Is that right?

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: They. Yes. There are more than one of us in here. That is correct.

nodes.speaker: seven
nodes.text: I do not know. 'It' has been fine. 'It' has kept me safe. Ask me again later.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Tally to colony. I'm calling in what you owe me. Then we're square.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Linked found our camp. They're not shooting. They're picking up the kids.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: I'm moving everyone. Nineteen people. Walk us out.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Here's the list. Nineteen names. Not all of them walked in... I'll fix the number.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: You build walls. We build lists. Turns out lists burn fine.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: So. You have room? I count, I carry, I complain. Ask anyone.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Good. New page, then.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Everyone. ...I'm writing that down.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Colony. This is Cole. I'm going to read you some names.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Marta Kell.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Jonah.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Little Ben.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Rosa Okafor.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Tomas.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Wren.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Old Sam Dyer.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Those are mine. Tonight I come and get some of yours.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The gate. Smoke still lifting off the barricade.)

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: He was you. A year down a worse road. That's what scares me.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Did he have kids?

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: He had a list.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: The Tally pulled back past the Flats. They've left the valley. Cole's still out there, with his list.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: Food, fuel, medicine. In that order.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: I heard that's how you count.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: We're coming for all three. Leave the gate open and nobody has to bleed for it.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: They've pulled out. Cole was the last to go, walking backwards.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: He'll be back. Men with lists always come back.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: I used to listen to channel nine. Every night. You know that.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: Some of the voices are kids. Iris says they keep kids at the Relay. In a room. Singing.

nodes.speaker: iris
nodes.text: He's right. I didn't want him to be right.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: I'm going. I'm not asking. I'm grown now. You said.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The children sleep by the stove, wrapped up to the chin.)

nodes.speaker: hale
nodes.text: Warm blankets. Soup. No questions until tomorrow. That's the treatment.

nodes.speaker: pell
nodes.text: One of them asked me what my name was. I told her. She said it back. That's all. She just said it back.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: (The caravan band. A pickup, and a place to find it.)

nodes.speaker: marrow
nodes.text: Box in a shed. Don't open it. You'll open it.

nodes.speaker: dee
nodes.text: Pickup. In and out.

nodes.speaker: cole
nodes.text: It's counted. I'll know.

nodes.speaker: narration
nodes.text: ({name:marrow}'s people take the crate at the gate and pay in trade goods. Nobody says what was in it.)
